title: Retry a Callable only for selected exceptions
contract: Attempts the task up to maxAttempts times. Returns the first successful value immediately, making no further attempt. On failure, retries only while the predicate accepts the exception and attempts remain; otherwise throws RetryExhaustedException whose cause is the last exception and whose getAttempts() is the number of attempts made. Null task or predicate, or maxAttempts below 1, throw IllegalArgumentException.
notShownInJavadoc: success on attempt k stops there
the cause is the last exception not the first
a non-retryable exception stops after one attempt
